seed carrying the new id, planted fault an add writing only the store;

commit.subject: Sync decisions seed with register writes
commit.body:
Load missing tracked seed rows into the SQLite store at first access, rewrite the seed after every successful writing verb, and support export --write with the tracked or an explicit destination.

Add World-planted coverage for the store-only add fault, seed-derived store startup, and both export write destinations. Fill LD-76's tests row with the measured focused command.
